research_period: Shows 10 September to 6 October 2026; Haute Couture, July 2026; Premiere Vision Paris, February 2026; analysis October to November 2026
markets: Global: New York, London, Milan, Paris and Copenhagen runways; premium and mid-market womenswear
title: SS27 Women's Couture Materials and Details
summary: Couture materials moved beyond silk and lace in 2026: lab-grown silk, silicone, latex, glass beads and feathers. The details that translate are feathers, satin macramé, corsetry and pearl beading.

sections.heading: The evidence
sections.body:
- **Lab-grown silk:** Balenciaga used AMSilk silk, which the house describes as "stronger than steel"<sup>[1]</sup>.
- **Silicone, latex, clay and paint:** Schiaparelli used poured silicone, sculpted clay, latex and paint<sup>[2]</sup>, and techniques from a workshop that makes lifelike silicone infants for films<sup>[1]</sup>.
- **Feathers:** goose and ostrich feathers at Balenciaga<sup>[2]</sup>, ostrich feathers at Stéphane Rolland<sup>[1]</sup>.
- **Satin macramé, agate and diamonds:** Stéphane Rolland<sup>[1]</sup>.
- **Beading:** a prom dress beaded in putty-pink pearls at Schiaparelli and hand-blown glass beads on tulle at Iris van Herpen<sup>[1]</sup>.
- **Velvet:** velvet roses at Zuhair Murad and velvet corseted gowns at Elie Saab<sup>[1]</sup>.

sections.heading: Details that translate
sections.body:
| Couture detail | Ready-to-wear translation | Price tier |
|---|---|---|
| Feathers | Feather trim at a hem or cuff | Premium |
| Satin macramé | Macramé belts and straps | Mid to premium |
| Pearl beading | Pearl buttons and beaded necklines | Mid to premium |
| Corsetry | Corset seaming and rubberised meshes<sup>[3]</sup> instead of boning | Mid |
| Moulded and coated surfaces | Coated lace and pearlescent satins<sup>[3]</sup> | Mid |

design_implications:
- Source feathers and beads from certified, traceable suppliers and state care clearly.
- Test coated and moulded materials for cracking and cleaning before committing.
commercial_implications:
- Keep exotic materials to a few showpieces; translate the look into accessible trims for volume.
- Lab-grown and bio-based materials carry a sustainability story: check claims before using them.
